title: Bloodline Resonance
next_chapter_hook: The eyes in the mural seemed to pierce through ten thousand years of time, locking with his gaze. Chen Ji dared to confirm—this was no coincidence—it was the bloodline responding. In the next chapter, he would face the identity he most dreaded: the last inheritor of the ancient Seer bloodline.

text.content: The whisper seared into Chen Ji's soul like a branding iron. He stood before the ancient stone door, feeling the blood in his veins churning like molten lava—a force more primal and violent than the backlash of the Tianji Record. Deep within his bloodline, something seemed to be awakening. The runes on the stone door began to emanate a ghostly blue glow, spreading outward in concentric circles, as if recognizing something.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) That voice... why does it feel like it's carved into my bones?

text.content: The stone door slid open silently, without any obstruction. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—he had clearly sensed that within this door lay formation arrays sufficient to annihilate a Nascent Soul cultivator. Yet now, those murderous rune patterns were retreating to either side like deferential servants. The restrictions hadn't failed; they were bowing to him.

Deep within the corridor, the night pearls embedded in the walls lit up one by one, as if welcoming their returning master. Chen Ji forced himself to remain calm. In his sea of consciousness, the Tianji Record fragment flickered with light—Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was awakening. Footsteps echoed through the empty passage, each step landing on the pulse of destiny.

dialogue.content: (Tianji Record remnant soul, aged and solemn) Child... your bloodline responds to this ruins. Move forward, but remember—whatever you see, do not resist the truth.

text.content: The corridor opened into vastness at its end. Chen Ji stepped into a massive underground hall, its dome soaring so high it seemed to pierce the clouds. The ceiling depicted celestial bodies and ancient gods locked in battle. And right in the center of the stone wall hung a portrait—its subject had refined, handsome features, with eye corners bearing the exact same curvature as Chen Ji's.

Chen Ji's heart seized. Below the portrait, dense rows of ancient prophetic words were carved. He could read them—somehow, these texts that should have been obscure and indecipherable flowed through him like an instinct inscribed in his bloodline, perfectly clear. 'The Seer's bloodline, the final inheritor...'

choice.prompt: The mural's words revealed Chen Ji might be the last inheritor of the Seer's bloodline. Facing this truth that could overturn all his understanding, Chen Ji chose—

choices.description: Reach out and touch the mural, actively awakening the dormant bloodline power, even if the cost is enduring the accumulated memory impacts of generations of Seers.
choices.visible_reward: Bloodline Awakening, gain partial memory inheritance of the ancient Seer
choices.risk_hint: Memory impact may cause soul turbulence, and will be detected by the Eye of Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingers pressing against the cold stone wall. In that instant, a scorching force surged into his body through his fingertips—a flood of memories spanning ten thousand years, carrying visions of blood and fire, came roaring forth.

choices.description: Suppress the shock in his heart, carefully study every detail within the mural, seeking clues from circumstantial evidence rather than reckless contact.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues to ancient scriptures hidden within the mural, providing intelligence advantage for subsequent planning
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal timing for bloodline awakening

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his outstretched hand, his knuckles faintly white. He stepped back two paces, his gaze sweeping across every line of the mural like a blade. The greatest gift the Tianji Record had given him wasn't the ability to foresee the future—it was patience.

The mural depicted an earth-shattering battle. In the nine heavens above, a colossal eye gazed down upon all living beings, its gaze holding no emotion—only cold order and rules. Beneath that eye, countless figures rose with arms raised—their pupils flickering with the same ghostly blue light Chen Ji now possessed. The Seers, they were called Seers.

Chen Ji's fingertip traced across the mural, touching a line of small text beneath the portrait. 'The Tianji Record is my legacy, the bloodline is the key, the inheritor should remember—' The words cut off abruptly here, as if deliberately leaving a blank. A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: indeed, from the very beginning there were no coincidences. The Tianji Record chose him, not because of luck, but because of his bloodline.

dialogue.content: (Remnant soul whispers) You see it now, don't you... the inheritance of the Tianji Record was never random. Before the previous Seer perished, he entrusted everything to your bloodline ancestor. And you... are the one chosen by the bloodline.

text.content:
A low rumble suddenly echoed from the depths of the hall.

The stone wall cracked open, and a ghostly blue pillar of light shot skyward, shining directly onto Chen Ji. That glow was warm and familiar, like a long-awaited embrace—

The dormant power within Chen Ji had fully awakened.

It was a force more primitive and purer than the Tianji Record, originating from the deepest depths of his bloodline, from the group of seers who dared to challenge the Heavenly Dao ten thousand years ago.

The moment his bloodline awakened, Chen Ji's perception underwent a dramatic transformation.

He "saw" the entire outline of this ruins—not with his eyes, but with the instinct flowing through his bloodline. Every restriction, every formation, every mechanism now lay bare before him like an unfolded chess manual.

And further away, he faintly sensed three familiar auras approaching.

choice.prompt: The bloodline awakening greatly expanded Chen Ji's perception range. He sensed three auras approaching the ruins. Should he immediately hide his aura, or use his newly awakened abilities to investigate the identities of those approaching?

choices.text: Investigate the Identities of the Approaching Individuals
choices.description: Utilize the enhanced perception from bloodline awakening to actively investigate the identities and intentions of the three auras, gaining the initiative before they discover him.
choices.visible_reward: Learn the specific identities and intentions of the approaching individuals, gain first-mover advantage
choices.risk_hint: Active investigation may expose one's own position

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes slightly closed as his bloodline power extended outward. After a moment, his brow tightly furrowed—among the three auras, one surprised him immensely.

choices.description: Conceal bloodline aura and blend into the shadows to observe the approaching individuals' movements. Utilize the recently acquired ruins perception ability to choose the most advantageous position for an ambush.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the mystery of bloodline awakening, allowing the other party to reveal more information while unaware
choices.risk_hint: May miss an important opportunity for intelligence gathering

text.content: Chen Ji concealed his aura, his form melting into the shadows. He coldly watched the direction of the light pillar, but in his heart was rapidly calculating—those approaching meant trouble, but revealing his trump cards at this moment was by no means the wise move.

Chen Ji suppressed the churning emotions in his heart, focusing his attention on the three auras.

The first, cold and sinister, carrying the corrosive aura unique to the Demonic Path—Ye Qing? No, stronger than Ye Qing, more ancient, a senior-level figure from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path.

The second, righteous and awe-inspiring, sword intent soaring to the heavens—the aura of Tianqing Sect. Han Lie? Or perhaps... Ling Yuan?

The third aura made Chen Ji's heart suddenly constrict.

It was faint and familiar, drifting like a gossamer thread, yet carrying an inexplicable sense of closeness—that was a bloodline aura from the same source as his!

"Impossible..." Chen Ji's pupils dilated sharply, "Chen Nian?"

His sister, missing for years, why would she appear here? Why would she appear alongside people from the Demonic Path and Tianqing Sect?

dialogue.content: (Grinding teeth, murmuring) Chen Nian... how are you here!

text.content:
Footsteps sounded at the hall entrance, and three figures slowly entered.

The leader was an elderly man in dark robes—Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect. Behind him followed a demonic path expert Chen Ji had never seen before, and most heart-wrenching of all—between them was a gaunt figure bound by chains.

That face, those eyes, were unmistakably his long-lost sister.

Ling Yuan surveyed his surroundings, his gaze finally fixed on the mural. His expression was extremely complex, carrying both the satisfaction of success and barely concealed wariness.

"It's indeed here..." Ling Yuan murmured, "The seer's bloodline, the inheritance of the Tianji Record... Today, this old man will completely erase it all."

The demonic path elder behind him sneered: "Old Ling, don't forget our agreement. This bloodline, and that Heavenly Fate Key, all belong to the Holy Sect."

Chen Ji hid in the shadows, his fingernails deeply embedded in his palms.

He gazed at his sister's pallid face, at the shocking wounds on her body, at those eyes that had once been clear but now filled with fear—

Somewhere in his heart, a string called reason snapped.

"Ling Yuan..." his voice was low as if from the depths of the Nine Nether Hells, "I originally wanted to drive you into a corner step by step, letting you taste the taste of despair. But you—more than anything else—you should not have touched my family.
